newsitem.title: USA: Medplus signs for $3 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: Medplus signs for $3 mln in financing.

text.p: MedPlus Corp said it had entered into a letter of intent with Wall Street Connections Inc for an equity financing of about $3 million.
The company said in a statement late on Thursday that under the terms of the transaction MedPlus will enter into an investment banking agreement with Wall Street Connections.

Wall Street Connections is finalizing an agreement with R.M. Stark & Co, of Boca Raton, Fla., as exclusive placement agent for a bridge funding of between $200,000 to $500,000, in the form of issuance of convertible bonds, and a subsequent offering for about $3 million via a private placement or secondary offering of MedPlus common stock.
Wall Street Connections is headquartered in Clearwater, Fla.
MedPlus, a health care financial management company, said proceeds from the proposed offering would go to expand its marketing activities and for acquisitions.
